text:
tara_cs: Quick sync — Gatekeeper pilot sent a post-onboard list of asks. Can product triage so CS can set renewal expectations?

tara_cs: Main items pasted below from their doc (short):
```
1) Per-route billing toggle (finance needs to split charges per customer route)
2) Export embeddings scoped to org (bulk export for our data team)
3) Local sync for on-prem agents (enterprise: nightly sync, no internet)
4) Improve Console step-through for first-run (UX pain during onboarding)
```

kevin_pm: Thanks. Which of these are blocking for their go-live / renewal?

tara_cs: Short answer: #1 and #3 are blockers; #2 is high value but not blocking; #4 is a UX polish that confuses new users but we can mitigate with docs. Their renewal is in 6 weeks — finance escalation on per-route billing. :warning:

sam_prod: Can you add one-line customer-impact statements? Helps prioritize. e.g., revenue at risk / manual work hours saved.

tara_cs: Sure: #1 -> prevents correct invoicing, finance will withhold payment until fixed. #3 -> security/compliance flag for their infra team (won't certify without local sync). #2 -> they'd love it for analytics (10+ analysts doing manual pulls). #4 -> onboarding NPS drops, causes extra support tickets.

kevin_pm: Engineering estimate needed. lee, can you ballpark effort? T-shirt / sprint estimate fine.

lee_eng: Rough off-the-cuff: #1 (per-route billing) touches billing svc + usage pipeline + console flags -> 2 devs x 4-6 weeks (includes QA + migrations). #3 (local sync) is infra-heavy -> 3-4 devs x 6-8 weeks, plus packaging. #2 (bulk embeddings export) -> 1 dev x 2-3 weeks. #4 (console step flow) -> 1 designer + 1 dev x 2-3 weeks.

kevin_pm: Oof. Given that, I'd rank priority: 1 > 3 > 2 > 4 (blocking + revenue risk). Can we create quick mitigations for #1 so they don't churn while we scope full work?

tara_cs: We've offered a manual billing export and interim CSV transform; finance said it's painful but acceptable for 4-6 weeks if we commit to roadmap. I'll push that as an offer.

feedback-bot: Created issue RD-4331: "Gatekeeper: per-route billing investigation / interim export" assigned to @lee_eng.

kevin_pm: Good. Let's capture impact/effort scores for the roadmap board. I'll add: Impact=9/10 Effort=8/10 for #1, Impact=8 Effort=9 for #3, Impact=7 Effort=3 for #2, Impact=5 Effort=2 for #4.

sam_prod: Can CS gather the customer's internal priority (rank 1-4) so we can align? Tara, can you ask the customer to do a short rank and send back by EOD?

tara_cs: On it. I'll ping them now and paste their ranking here when they reply.

lee_eng: FYI, if we take #1 as a high-priority spike, can we do an API-only intermediate that avoids console work? That could shave ~2 weeks.

kevin_pm: Yes please propose API-only path in RD-4331. Add acceptance criteria and a minimal migration plan.

tara_cs: Customer replied: ranking: 1) per-route billing 2) local sync 3) bulk export 4) console flow. They marked renewal risk "medium-high" if #1 not committed.

kevin_pm: Thanks team. Action items: tara -> confirm interim CSV offer and capture acceptance; lee -> add API-only spike plan to RD-4331; kevin -> add priority/impact to roadmap board and schedule a short grooming spike.

tara_cs: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam_prod: Adding note to account health doc and renewal tracker.

tara_cs: Closing thread for now; will repost once customer confirms interim acceptance.
